positive_cases.name: run_value_user_temp
positive_cases.scenario: Run value written referencing the per-user temporary directory.
positive_cases.rationale: Autostart key and writable value selections both match.

positive_cases.name: runonce_value_public
positive_cases.scenario: RunOnce value written referencing the public profile directory.
positive_cases.rationale: Autostart key and writable value selections both match.

negative_cases.name: run_value_managed_path
negative_cases.scenario: Run value written referencing a managed program directory.
negative_cases.rationale: Autostart key matches but the value data is not user writable.

negative_cases.name: application_setting_temp_path
negative_cases.scenario: Application setting written referencing a temporary cache directory.
negative_cases.rationale: Value data matches but the key is not an autostart location.

notes: All events are synthetic. Negative cases are deliberate near misses that exercise one failing selection each.
